name: Mrs Petra Food
old_description: At Mrs. Petra Food, we are committed to delivering the highest quality products, adhering to all health and safety regulations, and consistently bringing the same delicious flavor to your table every time.
about: Mrs. Petra Food operates from Orlando, Florida, producing a line of frozen potato-based snacks. The company’s founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, nor are the names of its founders. The product lineup centers on potato balls sold in one-pound bags, offered in four varieties: Four Cheese, Cheddar Cheese, Mozzarella Cheese, and Traditional. The company also sells frozen french fries. Manufacturing processes, facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not specified. Mrs. Petra Food reaches customers primarily through its own e-commerce website, shipping directly to consumers. The site also features recipe ideas such as cheesy bacon fries and salmon in white sauce, suggesting a home-cooking audience. No industrial or foodservice accounts are identified in the available information. The company states its commitment to delivering the highest quality products while adhering to all health and safety regulations, aiming to bring consistent flavor to every order.
